name: The Night Belle
source:
Hailey moves to Denver, CO and spends time at The Broken String, a popular Rock themed venue with live music. She also meets Rhiannon Lopez, the most popular guitarist and singer at that club and slowly becoming the most known musician in all of Denver.

[From [url=https://inuranma.itch.io/rock-queen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Hailey搬到科罗拉多州丹佛市，在The Broken String度过一段时光，这是一个流行的摇滚主题场所，有现场音乐表演。她还遇到了莱安农·洛佩兹（Rhiannon Lopez），他是该俱乐部最受欢迎的吉他手和歌手，并逐渐成为丹佛最著名的音乐家。

[来自[url=https://inuranma.itch.io/rock-queen]itch.io[/url]]
